_meta.title: GridWise adversarial paraphrase test pack
_meta.purpose: Hammer the LLM interpretation path with hidden-test-style wording BEFORE the round. Every entry is an original wording (public sample phrasing deliberately avoided). Run: python tests/test_paraphrase.py
_meta.note: expected.structured_adjustment uses the same shape the API returns. expected.source = 'llm' means the LLM must get it right; 'emergency' entries exercise the fallback classifier.
